lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz the next day he told me he took ‘um off.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. And where did he say he put ‘um? I heard that he showed them to you.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he show them to you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Not that I know of. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where do you think the knife is now?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Come on, Brendan. Where do you think the knife is? Do you have it at your house?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What did he give you as a souvenir for this?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What about the hair? Did you cut the hair off like you said earlier or is that a lie.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did you lie about that?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Relaxed? Good. So what you’re telling me now is all the truth? So, you didn’t cut any hair off?
